text:
[IRET.12.1] **Justification.** When a firing runs an
`ACTION_LOGICAL_ASSERT` ([RLOW.7.1.3]) and so emits a logical fact F
([LLOG.15.1]), the engine:

1. Asserts F into working memory (may be a no-op if F
   already exists with matching slot values).
2. Increments `F->justif_count`.
3. Records the pair `(activation_id → fact_id)` in the
   dependency table.

idris.name: iret_12_1__reach_input
idris.note: One seed and the two edges of a 2-cycle.

idris.name: iret_12_1__reach_prog
idris.note: Seed, then `gap__grow` closing Reach over the edges, then the seed's withdrawal; Reach a `logical` relation, the rest explicit. The `+recursive` proposal's shape.

idris.name: iret_12_1__seed_rule
idris.note: `Seed s -> emit Reach(1,2) logical`: the seed justification of the reach witness.

idris.name: iret_12_2__reach_engine_run
idris.note: Executed and checked firing by firing: the seed justifies Reach(1,2), `grow` justifies Reach(1,1), the no-op re-emit justifies Reach(1,2) a second time as step 2 says, the seed's withdrawal ends its activation and Reach(1,2) keeps one justification. Both Reach facts are live at the end.

idris.name: iret_10_2__record
idris.note: Steps 1-3 for one logical emit: the row is added whether or not the assert was a no-op, since the clause increments the count either way, and targets the fact live afterwards (the fresh one on an entity replace).

idris.name: iret_12_1__count
idris.note: `justif_count`: the rows of the table targeting the fact.

idris.name: Iret_12_1__justif
idris.note: The clause's dependency-table pair: the antecedents a rule activation matched and the `logical` fact it emitted.

idris.name: iret_12_1__supported_append_inv
idris.note: Support under two lists together comes from one of them.

idris.name: iret_12_1__supported_append_l
idris.note: Support under a justification list survives appending another.

idris.name: iret_12_1__supported_append_r
idris.note: Support under the appended list, likewise.

idris.name: iret_12_1__supported_inv
idris.note: Support taken apart: `justif_count > 0` exhibits the justification that provides it, with every antecedent live.

idris.name: iret_12_1__supported_of
idris.note: Support put together: a recorded justification with every antecedent live supports its target.

idris.name: iret_12__supported
idris.note: Step 2's `justif_count`, as the predicate "positive against the live set".

idris.name: iret_12_1__count_row
idris.note: A nonzero `justif_count` exhibits a row with the target.
